first_party_context.relevance: Dated pre-enforcement broad-market composite distinguishes the existing backdrop from the newly announced bank-specific action. It cannot explain BAC price changes.
Dated broad risk-appetite measurement, used only to describe conditions preceding the agency action, never a bank-specific solvency or credit measure.
Dated normalized volatility component, not a volatility percentage or a prediction of BAC moves; separates broad conditions from the enforcement event.
Dated broad sentiment measurement provides a separately computed pre-event baseline. It is not investor reaction to this announcement.
Dated broad risk model identifies rates as the existing macro pressure. It does not quantify BAC regulatory exposure or attribute any price change to the fine.
